items.title: Leonardo’s UK Loss Shows the Cost of Renting Hotels
items.why: Lease-heavy hotel operators face margin pressure, so asset strength matters when vetting lodging partners for premium perks.
items.summary_ai: Leonardo's UK hotels earn from guests but not enough to cover rent, as rising costs and new supply strain its lease-heavy model.
items.take: Lease-heavy hotel operators face margin pressure, so asset strength matters when vetting lodging partners for premium perks.
